description: Create a Dataverse environment in the tenant. Consumes tenant capacity: requires confirm: true. Runs 'pac admin create' with the active pac auth profile. Mutates a live environment: requires confirm: true (a dry run otherwise).

appVersion.description: (Preview) Pin the application build, e.g. 10.0.43; Finance & Operations and Project Operations templates only

background.description: Run in the background and return a jobId immediately, for a command that takes longer than the client will wait. Poll cs_job_status.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

cwd.description: Working directory for pac (for project commands: the solution project folder)

domain.description: Domain part of the environment URL

enableDemoData.description: (Preview) Install demo data; Finance & Operations and Project Operations templates only

enableDevTools.description: (Preview) X++ developer tooling; Finance & Operations and Project Operations templates only, ignored otherwise

enableTestModules.description: (Preview) Install the F&O test modules; Finance & Operations and Project Operations templates only

macroRegion.description: Macro-region id instead of a region, for tenants with Advanced Data Residency (pac 2.12)

maxAsyncWaitTime.description: Max asynchronous wait time in minutes (default 60)

platformVersion.description: (Preview) Pin the platform build, e.g. 7.0.7256; needs appVersion

profile.description: pac auth profile to run as: the admin account for tenant commands. Defaults to CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE for admin commands and CPS_PAC_PROFILE otherwise, then the active profile. cs_init lists the profiles.

securityGroupId.description: Entra security group id (required for a Teams environment)

type.description: Production, Sandbox, Trial, Developer or Teams

user.description: User to assign to the environment (object id or UPN)

name: cs_admin_create_environment
title: Create an environment
